title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards Balance Protection: Lost and Stolen Cards
content:
**Terms.** Balance protection on Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards exists only for a card that was registered to the holder's profile before it was lost, and only for a kind that both can be registered and carries lost-card protection. The card is registered to the caller's profile. On the report the card is frozen, and the balance at the time of the report is moved, within the kind's business days to issue a replacement, to a replacement card of the same kind for the kind's replacement fee, after which the old card number closes; value spent before the report is not restored. An unregistered card, a Corporate Gift Card or a Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card is treated as cash and is not replaced. A frozen card found before the replacement is issued can be unfrozen at the holder's request.

## Registration

A holder registers a card to their profile for balance protection; once registered, the card's record shows it as registered to that holder. Registration is available only for kinds that can be registered.

## Who may report a card lost or stolen

The card is registered to the caller's profile. This is judged on the card's own record — whether it is registered, and the customer to whom it belongs — and that customer is the caller. The caller's statement that the card is theirs does not stand in for the record.

## What follows a report

| Stage | Effect on the card |
|---|---|
| Report | The card is frozen; the date of the report is recorded |
| Within the kind's business days to issue a replacement | The balance at the time of the report moves to a replacement card of the same kind, for the kind's replacement fee |
| Once the balance has moved | The old card number closes |
| Card found before the replacement is issued | At the holder's request the frozen card is unfrozen and becomes active again |

Value spent before the report is not restored: the replacement receives only the balance at the time of the report.

## Paired cases (hypothetical)

- *Registered and protected.* A hypothetical Marlowe & Finch eGift Card registered to the caller's profile is reported stolen with $75.00 on it. The card is frozen, and $75.00 moves to a replacement Marlowe & Finch eGift Card within that kind's replacement period, after which the old number closes.
- *Not registered.* A hypothetical Marlowe & Finch Gift Card that was never registered is reported lost. It is treated as cash and is not replaced.
- *Registered to someone else.* A hypothetical card whose record shows it registered to a different customer's profile is not frozen on this caller's report.
- *Found in time.* A hypothetical registered Merchandise Credit Card, frozen on a report, is found by its holder before the replacement is issued; at the holder's request it is unfrozen.
